portablePackage.name: PhysioAIFaultEvidenceKit
portablePackage.scope: Foundation-only derived JSON contract; no camera, MediaPipe, model, or network dependency

ruleBasedSession.delivery: user-initiated temporary JSON file plus iOS share sheet; no Dashboard, backend, Railway, LLM, or automatic persistence

export.trigger: Debug V8 session-summary action after at least one completed repetition
export.destination: user-selected Files, AirDrop, or share-sheet destination
export.validation: decode known RuleBasedSessionRecord and reconcile summary with repetition rows before file creation

ruleBasedSession.hostBoundary: host owns MediaPipe, Capture-QC and completed rep boundaries; package aggregates qualified derived fault signals
ruleBasedSession.severityMeaning: rule-evidence severity only; not clinical severity
ruleBasedSession.correctnessMeaning: experimental visible-fault rule outcome only; cannot_assess is separate from incorrect

sitToStandRuleBasedSession.delivery: user-initiated temporary JSON file plus iOS share sheet; adapter-ready but not uploaded
sitToStandRuleBasedSession.hostBoundary: host owns MediaPipe, Pose admission, geometry counter and completed rep boundaries; observer aggregates only qualified derived Pose geometry signals
sitToStandRuleBasedSession.severityMeaning: development rule-evidence severity only; not clinical severity
sitToStandRuleBasedSession.correctnessMeaning: experimental visible-form outcome only; cannot_assess is separate from incorrect

planDoseExecution.scope: selected native rep-count plan item only for Bottle Grab and Sit-to-Stand; extras remain manual development practice
planDoseExecution.completion: one-shot local Summary transition when counter-owned total reaches reps × sets
planDoseExecution.counterAdmission: host pauses further counting before exercise-specific final evidence preparation; V8.0.15 Sit-to-Stand counter calibration is declared separately; model weights and PhaseNet features retain their provenance
planDoseExecution.evidenceFinalization: Bottle Grab allows a brief Hand-callback grace period; Sit-to-Stand finalizes only completed geometry-counter repetitions without inventing a fault
planDoseExecution.export: Debug Summary user action only; no automatic file sharing or backend/dashboard delivery

postSessionScoring.scope: experimental per-exercise rule feedback for bottle_grab and sit_to_stand
postSessionScoring.inputs: validated completed-repetition RuleBasedSessionRecord plus counter-owned completed-repetition total for coverage denominator
postSessionScoring.sessionAggregateDelivery: overall_score, pose_score, and invalid_reps use the existing exercise_sessions save path; motion_score remains null
postSessionScoring.detailedEvidenceDelivery: not connected to Dashboard, backend, Railway, or LLM
